definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named K statement term for the Python loop body.
definitions.text:
rule nextSmallestLoopBody =>
    If(Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
       Assign(Name("smallest"), Name("value"))
       Assign(Name("count"), Int(1)),
       If(Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp("<", Name("smallest"))),
          Assign(Name("second"), Name("smallest"))
          Assign(Name("count"), Int(2))
          Assign(Name("smallest"), Name("value")),
          If(Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp("!=", Name("smallest"))),
             If(BoolOp("or",
                       (Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Int(1))),
                        Compare(Name("value"), CmpOp("<", Name("second"))),
                        .Exprs)),
                Assign(Name("second"), Name("value"))
                Assign(Name("count"), Int(2)),
                .Stmts) .Stmts,
             .Stmts) .Stmts))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named post-loop return statement sequence.
definitions.text:
rule nextSmallestReturn =>
    If(Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Int(2))),
       Return(Name("second")) .Stmts,
       .Stmts)
    Return(NoneVal)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion composing initialization, the loop, and return into the function body term.
definitions.text:
rule nextSmallestBody =>
    Assign(Name("smallest"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("second"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("count"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("value"), Int(0))
    For(Name("value"), Name("lst"), nextSmallestLoopBody)
    nextSmallestReturn

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named module term containing next_smallest.
Base equation defining the emptiness observer on nilInts.

Terminal equation of the nsScan mathematical summary when a second distinct value is present.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, _:Int, N:Int, C:Int) => N
    requires intsEmpty(IS) andBool C ==Int 2

definitions.rationale: Terminal equation of nsScan returning noneV when no second distinct value is present.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, _:Int, _:Int, C:Int) => noneV
    requires intsEmpty(IS) andBool notBool (C ==Int 2)

definitions.rationale: Recursive nsScan equation that initializes the minimum from the first observed input value.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, _:Int, N:Int, C:Int)
    => nsScan(intsTail(IS), intsHead(IS), N, 1)
    requires notBool intsEmpty(IS) andBool C ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Recursive nsScan equation for observing a new minimum and shifting the old minimum to second.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, S:Int, _:Int, C:Int)
    => nsScan(intsTail(IS), intsHead(IS), S, 2)
    requires notBool intsEmpty(IS) andBool notBool (C ==Int 0)
     andBool intsHead(IS) <Int S

definitions.rationale: Recursive nsScan equation preserving the state when the observed value duplicates the minimum.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, S:Int, N:Int, C:Int)
    => nsScan(intsTail(IS), S, N, C)
    requires notBool intsEmpty(IS) andBool notBool (C ==Int 0)
     andBool intsHead(IS) ==Int S

definitions.rationale: Recursive nsScan equation that records the first distinct value above the minimum.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, S:Int, _:Int, C:Int)
    => nsScan(intsTail(IS), S, intsHead(IS), 2)
    requires notBool intsEmpty(IS) andBool C ==Int 1
     andBool intsHead(IS) >Int S

definitions.rationale: Recursive nsScan equation that replaces the second candidate with a smaller admissible value.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, S:Int, N:Int, C:Int)
    => nsScan(intsTail(IS), S, intsHead(IS), 2)
    requires notBool intsEmpty(IS) andBool notBool (C ==Int 0)
     andBool notBool (C ==Int 1)
     andBool intsHead(IS) >Int S andBool intsHead(IS) <Int N

definitions.rationale: Recursive nsScan equation that preserves the second candidate when the observed value is no smaller.
definitions.text:
rule nsScan(IS:Ints, S:Int, N:Int, C:Int)
    => nsScan(intsTail(IS), S, N, C)
    requires notBool intsEmpty(IS) andBool notBool (C ==Int 0)
     andBool notBool (C ==Int 1)
     andBool intsHead(IS) >Int S andBool intsHead(IS) >=Int N

source_rules.rationale: Trusted loop-summary fact used by the entry proof; Stage 1 proved only a weaker claim with an existential final scopes map, not this rule's exact specific scope-deletion consequent.
source_rules.text:
rule
    <k>
      #loop(list(intVals(INPUT:Ints)),
            Name("value"),
            nextSmallestLoopBody)
      ~> nextSmallestReturn
      ~> #endcall
    =>
      nsScan(INPUT, SMALLEST:Int, SECOND:Int, COUNT:Int)
      ~> CONT:K
    </k>
    <env> 1 => 0 </env>
    <scopes>
      (SC:Map
       1 |-> scope(("value" |-> OLD_VALUE:Int
                    "lst" |-> LST:Val
                    "smallest" |-> SMALLEST
                    "second" |-> SECOND
                    "count" |-> COUNT),
                   parent(0)))
    =>
      ((SC
        1 |-> scope(("value" |-> OLD_VALUE
                     "lst" |-> LST
                     "smallest" |-> SMALLEST
                     "second" |-> SECOND
                     "count" |-> COUNT),
                    parent(0))) [1 <- undef])
    </scopes>
    <scopeLoc> 2 => 1 </scopeLoc>
    <heap> HEAP:Map </heap>
    <heapLoc> HLOC:Int </heapLoc>
    <stack>
      ListItem(frame(CONT, 0, 1)) REST:List
    =>
      REST
    </stack>
    <ret> noRet </ret>
    <exc> EXC:Exc </exc>
    <exit-code> CODE:Int </exit-code>
    requires notBool (1 in_keys(SC))
    [priority(40)]
